people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he, and the whole army with him, including all the mighty men of valor.
translations.bsb: So Joshua and his whole army, including all the mighty men of valor, came from Gilgal.
translations.kjv: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
translations.asv: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valor.
